title: Barber's symptoms compared with John Burroughs' from Rendlesham

tellings.quote: John Burroughs and Jim Penniston. John Burrows had had similar symptoms that I did and had similar issues with his VA records as I did.

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he flew a helicopter to recover a UFO, tells Michels that his own health problems match those of John Burroughs, one of the US airmen, with Jim Penniston, at the 1980 Rendlesham Forest incident in England, where servicemen reported a strange craft near an air base. Barber says Burroughs 'had similar symptoms that I did and had similar issues with his VA records,' meaning his veterans' medical files, a link he connects to the scientist Garry Nolan. If true, contact with such craft may leave the same marks on people decades apart.
